note.p: Robert Graham admitted Inner Temple 8.4.1766, barrister at law subscr to HMWilliams' poems 1786 and Jebb's Works 1787, admitted Lincolns Inn 1793 1st son of James of Dalston, Kings Counsel 1800, 6 Lincolns Inn Stone Bldgs, Prince of Wales' attorney-general, Recorder of Oakhampton, Counsel for Univ of Cambridge DNB1744-1836. Quite likely the 1789 entry possibly others.

But also possible: Sir Bellingham Graham baronet, member of Friends to the People 1792 died 1796. Also: Thomas and James Graham 1800 Law List attornies 6 Lincolns Inn New Sq Thomas G of Lincolns Inn PCC 1813 William G of Lincolns Inn PCC 1811 John Graham, sheriff's broker for Middlesex, 83 Chancery Lane James Graham Esq Boyle's 1792, 10 Lincolns Inn Fields, subscr to Aeneid 1794, adm Lincolns Inn 1780, Hist of Parl 1753-1825 (father of Sandford 1778-1852 below) / 28.4.1801 Mrs G's rout Lincolns Inn Fields
